name: Qualifacts Credible
short_description: End-to-end enterprise behavioral health EHR for large agencies, CCBHCs, and human service organizations with configurable workflows and advanced analytics.
long_description: Qualifacts Credible is an end-to-end behavioral health platform designed for large enterprise agencies and Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinics (CCBHCs). As part of the Qualifacts portfolio, Credible delivers configurable workflows, integrated billing, mobile access, and advanced analytics to help providers streamline documentation, ensure compliance, improve client outcomes, and accelerate revenue collection. The platform serves diverse behavioral health and human service programs including large enterprise agencies, multi-location and multi-specialty organizations, SUD treatment facilities, residential and inpatient programs, and Autism/IDD services. Credible is positioned for organizations with the most complex requirements, offering deep customization capabilities, robust reporting, and enterprise-grade scalability.
one_liner: Enterprise EHR platform for the most complex behavioral health and human service organizations.
best_for: Large enterprise behavioral health agencies (200+ users)
CCBHCs requiring comprehensive compliance and outcome tracking
Residential and inpatient behavioral health programs
not_for: Solo practitioners or small private practices
Organizations with limited IT resources for implementation
Practices seeking simple, quick-start EHR solutions

pricing.notes: Starting costs approximately $45,000/year on quote-based model. Per-user estimates $100-$200/user/month for smaller organizations, scaling down with headcount. Implementation costs range $5,000-$50,000+. Add-on features like IQ analytics and client portal may have additional costs. Budget conservatively for implementation, training, and add-on modules.

faqs.q: How much does Qualifacts Credible cost?
faqs.a: Credible starts at approximately $45,000/year on a quote-based model. Per-user estimates range from $100-$200/user/month for smaller organizations. Implementation can cost $5,000-$50,000+. Contact Qualifacts for enterprise pricing.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Credible and CareLogic?
faqs.a: Both are Qualifacts products for enterprise behavioral health. Credible is designed for the largest and most complex organizations including enterprise agencies, multi-location operations, and residential/inpatient programs. CareLogic serves community mental health centers and mid-size organizations.

faqs.q: Is Credible suitable for small practices?
faqs.a: No, Credible is designed for large enterprise agencies with 200+ users. Small practices and solo practitioners should consider CareLogic or other more appropriately-sized solutions.

faqs.q: Does Credible support residential treatment programs?
faqs.a: Yes, Credible is specifically designed to support residential and inpatient behavioral health programs with specialized workflows, documentation, and compliance features for these settings.
